name: Magos Luxus

bonuses.name: Autonomous Targeting
bonuses.text: Each round, this Threat can make a standard ranged attack Action as a Free Action.

bonuses.name: Diffractor Field
bonuses.text: The Magos Luxus is protected by an arcane energy field. This grants him +5 Defence against LAS weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Point Defence Lasers
abilities.text: As a Reaction to any PROJECTILE attack, the Magos can make an opposed Ballistic Skill (AGI) Test. If he succeeds the projectile is vapourised harmlessly.

determination: Extensive Augmetics: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6.
note: Keywords printed with NECRON (no SERVITOR or FORGE WORLD); kept as printed.
